description: This file defines an Android activity called BouncingBalls that demonstrates animation of bouncing balls with touch interaction and color transitions. It includes internal classes for managing the drawing and animation of individual balls.

classes.name: BouncingBalls
classes.description: Main activity that initializes and manages the bouncing balls animation view.

classes.name: MyAnimationView
classes.description: Custom View class responsible for rendering and animating the bouncing balls, handling touch events, and managing animations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and adds the animation view.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles touch events to create and animate new bouncing balls.

methods.name: addBall
methods.description: Creates a new ball ShapeHolder at specified coordinates with random color and gradient.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Renders all balls in the current list onto the Canvas.
